newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease to end at 20.75 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease to end at 20.75 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates eased a shade on Monday in abundant money supply, traders said.
"Offers dominated during a fairly busy morning," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
Overnight rates ended at 20.75 percent compared with Friday's close of 20.75/20.875 percent but Tolonics said it was difficult to predict which way rates would move on Tuesday.
"The impact of quarterly VAT payments due on Tuesday is hard to judge," he said.
He added that market players no longer put all available funds in the central bank's reverse repo facility as an imminent rate cut has large been discounted.
The National Bank of Hungary's one-week reverse repo rate currently stands at 21 percent.
